2610.07132.title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
2610.07132.paper_summary: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.
2610.07132.paper_summary_zh: Croissant 已經成為機器可讀數據集元數據的標準，但填寫其字段仍然需要大量人力，並且需要仔細閱讀伴隨的數據集文檔。我們提出了第一個基準，能夠進行與社區標準架構對齊的元數據提取的端到端評估。該基準包含 602 篇論文，其中包括 102 篇經過人工驗證的金標註和 500 篇由 LLM 生成的銀標註，涵蓋了完整的 Croissant 架構，包括核心和負責任的人工智慧 (RAI) 字段。利用這個基準，我們評估了一系列提取系統，涵蓋前沿模型、開放權重模型和代理架構，並在一個兩級評估框架下進行，該框架結合了基於規則的評分和通過人工審核選擇的 LLM 評審。我們發現，單次提取在我們評估的四個代理架構中始終表現更好：在各個主幹中，這些分解變體的準確性低於單次全上下文提取。最大的差距出現在長格式的 RAI 字段，這需要綜合和解釋分散在論文中的信息，而不是從單一位置複製，這是一個當前系統仍然遠未可靠的情境。我們釋出基準、評估代碼、評審審核、實時演示以及面向新系統的排行榜。
